note: Static item definitions. An owned item is a row in t_item and may name one of these with definition_id; the row keeps the wire fields CREATE_NAMED_ITEM carries, so an old row without a definition still rebuilds its message exactly. Names are UTF-16 code units because an item name is not always a string (the backpack's is a packed Gw.dat template id). "live": true means the client item probe has shown this exact wire identity and /item may grant it.

definitions.doc: The item that is the backpack. It has no bag or slot of its own; the backpack bag names it with assoc_item_id. Its one modifier is HoldsItems(20).
The Birthday Cupcake, a stackable Sweet. The reference puts two stacks of 100 in the backpack; one stack holds up to 250.
The Prophecies warrior's starting hammer, from the reference's default equipment. It is a main-hand weapon, worn in equipped slot 0.
The Prophecies warrior's starting chest piece. Equipped slot 2 is the body.
The Prophecies warrior's starting leggings. Equipped slot 3 is the legs.
The Prophecies warrior's starting head piece. Equipped slot 4 is the head.
The Prophecies warrior's starting boots. Equipped slot 5 is the boots.
The Prophecies warrior's starting gloves. Equipped slot 6 is the gloves.
